824-2511-2728-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2511-2728-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2511-2728-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

2893-3470-6763-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3179-4399-4518-4716.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-4716.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2092-2757-5140-6296.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping Jirina, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Jirina by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2104-3277-7631.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch
When the Izzet Chronarch token enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

104-1086-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1086-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1017-2275-6980.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-2275-6980.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz and Wizard Class trigger for each card drawn.
Resolve all Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz for each trigger.
Resolve the first Wizard Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fetid Gargantua.
Fetid Gargantua triggers, causing you to draw two cards and lose 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.
1017-2275-6980.notes: With the additional Wizard Class trigger, you can target any creature you control to put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

1844-3967-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-3967-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1729-2178-4481.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Heavy Arbalest attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

703-803-4394-5231.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, mutating it over or under a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two copies of the Feather token that are 3/3 Dragon creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Astral Dragon, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Astral Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

152-851-6252.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Boommobile.
When the Boommobile tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
152-851-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

5256-6247-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5256-6247-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1491-2464-4565-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.

Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you would draw by causing each player to return a permanent to their hand instead.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to return Mox Amber from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind.

891-2386-2438-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
891-2386-2438-5220.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1819-4211-5509-5510.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of copies of Rat Colony in your library greater than your maximum hand size minus the number of cards in your hand.
1819-4211-5509-5510.description:
Cast Secret Salvage by paying {3}{B}{B}, exiling Rat Colony from your graveyard and causing you to search your library for all copies of Rat Colony in your library and put them into your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Move to your cleanup step, causing you to discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard as many copies of Rat Colony as possible.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card discarded this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card exiled this way, dealing that much damage to each opponent.

1020-1117-2034-5121.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.

When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.

Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.

Repeat step 2.

1883-3129.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a creature token.

Resolve the copy of Replcation Technique, creating two token copies of Primal Vigor.

Create a creature token, causing you to instead create 2,048 creature tokens.

Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability, untapping all Forests.

Repeat.

Cast Snap.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
